items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section I, List of Answers on Terminology 19:1
items.html: Phase four of the will, which was emptied of light, is discerned as darkness in relation to the light; and in relation to the vessel she is discerned as “space,” for phase four herself was not withdrawn from the emanated being because of the restriction, but rather is present in it as an empty space without light. (Part 1, Item 1)
